status: HYPOTHESIS — practitioner validation gate pending (0 interviews)

company.business_model: dealer/distributor-led sales, regional field execution (TSO/ASM beats, CFA/depot fulfilment)

system_environment.pattern: DMS/SFA present-but-bypassed: parallel Tally billing, scheme leakage, secondary under-reporting, GPS distrust
system_environment.disqualify_if: verified live SFA accountability (GPS-verified visits + secondary in ERP, no Excel bridge) in silent audit

workflows: beat-plan → visit → proof-of-visit → demo/delivery data → EOD report → manager review
dealer order (phone/WhatsApp photo-list) → spec tracking → stock/credit check → billing (Tally vs DMS) → dispatch → claim/scheme settlement
what_goes_wrong: unwitnessed visits + territory rotation + tea-stall check-ins
45-60 min/day reporting tax (62% non-selling per MAssist)
order errors Rs800-1500 each, no audit trail
scheme not applied / wrong scheme / late claim; Rs50k-5L/quarter leakage per distributor; Rs10-50L stuck claims; 5-10% scheme overspend
secondary sales 15 days late / unstructured WhatsApp, no visibility
manager chasing via 80-100 WhatsApps/day, manual Excel/PPT mornings
problem.cost_of_current_state_formula: selling-hours burned (reps × 50min × fully-loaded cost) + claim leakage + stock-out loss + error rework; must be ≥10x pilot fee or disqualify
problem.why_unsolved: dot-on-map SaaS shows location not accountability; DMS-as-mandate fails with distributors (surveillance framing); 60% SFA failure (30-sec vs 3-min logging, English-only, offline gaps, 30-40% attrition)
problem.why_now_ai_plausible: GPS+mobile ubiquity + cheap anomaly scoring + WhatsApp-grade multilingual UX + ERP/WhatsApp integration deployable in 8-week non-invasive slice

strong: SFA/DMS rollout or renewal (Apollo FY26, CERA 50→200, Kajaria launch)
triggers.rule: Tier-1 requires structural-fit + ≥1 dated strong trigger + ≥1 pain-proximate artifact (review/complaint/JD/bypass evidence). Scale-only = Tier-3.

buying_committee.pain_owner: Head Sales / Regional Sales Head (field) + Head Dispatch where fleet
buying_committee.champion: high-performing ASM/Area Manager (lives reporting pain; 2-visit test: gave raw data unprompted + corrected us in front of team)
buying_committee.economic_buyer: Promoter/Owner-MD / Director-Sales / COO (owns secondary + claim P&L; shows up to field visit/review)
buying_committee.influencer: CFO/Finance (claim settlement, credit limits) + IT (SAP/DMS integration clearance)
buying_committee.do_not_start_at: CEO of 1000cr+ groups alone; IT manager alone

pilot.shape: One cluster/region (50-100 reps or 100-300 dealers), 4-6 weeks proof + 4-week pre-registered baseline, control region, finance-owned reconciliation
pilot.scope: GPS-verified coverage + WhatsApp-to-ERP orders + scheme auto-check + pending-claim list. NO rip-replace DMS. Hindi/regional + offline-first + <60-sec check-in.
pilot.kill_line: If coverage <target at week 3 OR no finance-data access OR enforcer unsigned → stop and publish learning
pilot.price_anchor: priced against measured glue-cost; paid pilot + success fee; no free dashboard

voice_entry_tactic.use: parallel 30%: dealer/retailer reactivation, distributor collections, repeat-ordering, NDR recovery in Hindi+; Bhajanlal proof (10k calls/day)
voice_entry_tactic.when: SFA locked 2-3yrs OR <200 dealers but >5k calls/month pending OR attrition >30% OR need fast session
voice_entry_tactic.gate: week-1 bar test on buyer recordings (one language, one queue); fail twice → kill voice for that account

geography.primary: India: West (Morbi ceramics, Mumbai-Pune pipes/paints), North (Delhi-UP-Rajasthan cement/pipes/plywood), South (TN/KA/AP/Telangana cement/ceramics/paints), East+NE (Star Cement footprint, plywood)
geography.secondary: Central (MP/Chhattisgarh: Sirca expansion, Sagar Cement ramp)
avoid: plant-towns with <50 dealers in 100km (unit economics fail)
monsoon-frozen beats Jun-Sep without season-window plan
geography.why: ICP density (dealer clusters + challenger plants) + buying power (Rs500-2000cr) + accessibility (Hindi/regional field + depot access) + adoption likelihood (challenger growth pressure), not company count

disqualifiers: <50 dealers or <10 reps in pilot region (economics fail)
pilot window inside scheme freeze with no control
confidence: MEDIUM-LOW (web evidence strong, zero interviews). Gate: 5 silent audits + 5 live calls + KREPL reference before locking.
